clips.title: The story
paras: In Shadowglen, Tarindrella seeks the cause of the forest’s sudden unrest and the furbolgs’ disappearance. Grells have turned aggressive, and Fel Moss points to dark magic in Teldrassil’s boughs.

Shadowglen’s quiet woods have grown hostile. The furbolgs have left their ancestral dens and gathered as the Gnarlpine tribe. Feral grells and grellkin now overrun the woodland paths, and Tarindrella has noticed the dark change spreading through Teldrassil.

Tarindrella suspects corruption is stirring the forest’s creatures. You slay the grells and bring her samples of Fel Moss, evidence of dark enchantments clinging to Teldrassil’s boughs. With the corruption confirmed, she sends young defenders to Dolanaar to speak with Druid Athridas Bearmantle.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Something evil is brewing in the forests of Teldrassil. Look long the hills to where the peaceful furbolgs used to dwell. They have deserted their homes and are amassing under the name of the Gnarlpine tribe.
Only the corruption of wicked Fel Moss could cause such a transformation. The grells and grellkin have infested the area and are threatening the residents of Shadowglen.
Engage these grells and grellkin, friend, and see if they are indeed caught under the enchantment of the wicked Fel Moss.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Satisfy my suspicions, friend. Bring to me 8 Fel Moss.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your service to the creatures of Shadowglen is worthy of reward, friend.
You confirmed my fears, however. If the grells have become tainted by the Fel Moss, one can only imagine what has become of the Gnarlpine tribe of furbolgs who once lived here.
Should you find yourself in Dolanaar, able Hunter, seek out the knowledgeable druid, Athridas Bearmantle. He shares our concern for the well being of the forest.
